meta.title: Pilih Pendidikan — CV, invoice and portfolio builders
meta.description: Document builders for students and job seekers: write a CV, an invoice or an Apple Developer Academy portfolio in your browser with a live preview, then download it as a PDF.
meta.ogDescription: Browser-based CV, invoice and portfolio builders with a live preview and PDF export.
meta.ogImageAlt: Pilih Pendidikan — CV, invoice and portfolio builders

hero.title: Pilih Pendidikan
hero.intro: Pilih Pendidikan is a set of document builders for students and job seekers, in English and Bahasa Indonesia. Each one runs in your browser, shows a live preview and exports a print-ready PDF.
hero.rollout: The builders are launching one at a time. Each one gets a link here once it is live.

cv.name: CV builder
cv.description: Write a CV in one of four templates and download it as a PDF.

invoice.name: Invoice builder
invoice.description: Create invoices with Indonesian region addresses and download them as PDFs.

portfolio.name: Portfolio builder
portfolio.description: Build an Apple Developer Academy portfolio in a fixed A4-landscape layout and export it as a PDF.

mcp.heading: AI assistants
mcp.name: Use it from an AI assistant (MCP)
mcp.description: An AI assistant that supports MCP can read and edit your CVs, invoices and portfolios for you.
